translations.web: You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.
translations.bsb: When You hide Your face, they are terrified; when You take away their breath, they die and return to dust.
translations.kjv: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.
translations.asv: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled; Thou takest away their breath, they die, And return to their dust.
